candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from order->payment call latency: payment POST /v1/authorizations spans ~2.0s and ends in transport ReadTimeout, propagating a 502 up through order to gateway /v1/checkout. Inventory/redis path succeeds (200), isolating the delay to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side cause (its own downstream, saturation, or config) not observable; logs excluded. ReadTimeout could reflect payment slowness or a client timeout setting.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent ~2s payment authorization ReadTimeouts producing 502s at order and gateway checkout, while inventory/redis succeed. Metrics show checkout p95 ~2406ms and 502s. Bounded candidate: downstream latency at the payment dependency. Payment-internal cause and timeout config remain unverified.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and traces to confirm payment-side slowness vs client timeout
Gateway/order client timeout configuration to distinguish slow dependency from short timeout
Excluded gateway logs (ev-48522bf71f38191a-r0-gateway_logs) for error detail
